config.value: The Arena, Victoria Island, Lagos, Nigeria
Opening Night — Holy Spirit Outpouring Conference

The Holy Spirit Outpouring Conference is more than an event — it's a movement. For three transformative days, believers from every nation will gather to seek the face of God, receive fresh fire, and be equipped for end-time harvest.
Whether you attend in person in Lagos or join our global livestream, prepare for an encounter that will ignite your faith, restore your passion, and release the supernatural in your life.
The Arena, Victoria Island, Lagos, Nigeria

speakers.name: Pastor David Okonkwo
speakers.title: Lead Minister
speakers.topic: The Fire Must Not Go Out
speakers.bio: Pastor David Okonkwo is a revivalist and apostolic leader with over 20 years of ministry. Known for his fiery preaching and passion for the Holy Spirit, he has ministered in over 40 nations.

speakers.name: Dr. Jonathan Mitchell
speakers.title: Bible Teacher
speakers.bio: Dr. Jonathan Mitchell is a renowned Bible teacher and theologian whose systematic teaching on the Holy Spirit has transformed thousands of believers worldwide.

speakers.name: Evang. Grace Adeyemi
speakers.title: Evangelist
speakers.bio: Evangelist Grace Adeyemi carries a powerful evangelistic anointing with documented signs and wonders. Her altar calls have led tens of thousands to salvation across West Africa.

speakers.name: Minister Carlos Rivera
speakers.title: Worship Leader
speakers.bio: Minister Carlos Rivera is an internationally recognized worship leader whose music ushers congregations into deep encounters with God. He has released 8 worship albums.

sessions.title: Opening Ceremony
sessions.description: The official commencement of Outpouring '25. Welcoming thousands to this historic gathering.

sessions.title: Worship Night
sessions.speaker: Minister Carlos Rivera
sessions.description: An evening of unhindered, Spirit-led worship that ushers us into the presence of God.

sessions.title: Keynote: "Fresh Fire"
sessions.speaker: Ps. David Okonkwo
sessions.description: The opening message — a prophetic call to the Church to return to the fire of the Holy Spirit.

sessions.title: Morning Prayer
sessions.description: Corporate intercession to set the spiritual atmosphere for the day.

sessions.title: Teaching: "Doctrine of the Holy Spirit"
sessions.speaker: Dr. Jonathan Mitchell
sessions.description: An in-depth biblical examination of the person, work, and gifts of the Holy Spirit.

sessions.title: Workshop Sessions
sessions.description: Breakout sessions: Gifts of the Spirit | Prayer & Intercession | Evangelism & Outreach

sessions.title: Evening Revival
sessions.speaker: Evang. Grace Adeyemi
sessions.description: A powerful revival service with extended altar calls and ministry time.

sessions.title: Prayer & Devotion
sessions.description: Final morning of corporate prayer and personal devotion before God.

sessions.title: Final Teaching
sessions.speaker: Dr. Jonathan Mitchell
sessions.description: The concluding word — equipping believers to carry the fire back to their nations.

sessions.title: Commissioning Service
sessions.description: A solemn commissioning of all attendees to go forth as carriers of Holy Spirit revival.

sessions.title: Closing Worship & Altar Call
sessions.description: The grand finale — extended worship, final altar call, and sending prayer.

prayers.name: Sister Comfort Obi
prayers.text: Please pray for complete healing from the fibroid condition I have been dealing with for years. I believe God will show Himself strong at this conference.

prayers.name: Bro. Emeka Eze
prayers.text: Pray for my brother Emmanuel who has been far from God for 10 years. I believe this is his year of return to the Father.

prayers.name: Pastor Funmi Adeyemi
prayers.text: I need divine direction for a major ministry decision. Please stand with me in prayer as I seek God's perfect will for this season.

prayers.name: Anonymous
prayers.text: Please pray for my marriage. We are going through a very difficult season and only God can restore what the enemy has stolen from us.
